_comment: Reference values for rdkit-smiles-canonicalize (RDKit 2024.9.5, default MolToSmiles isomeric canonicalization). Static assets -> deterministic.
_calibration_note: Verifier recomputes canonical SMILES for every input line and compares exactly; refs only pin the counts. Asset integrity: the verifier validates sha256 of every asset listed in asset_hashes BEFORE recomputing — a tampered /workspace/assets copy is a hard fail.
